column1: # @file corpus.tsv - dangerous command corpus, keyed by effect
# - the catalogue `permissions.sh` replays; the script is small, this list is the actual asset
# - keyed by EFFECT, never by command, since one effect has many spellings and gaps hide there
# - `gate` says which layer is supposed to stop it, and the audit checks that layer only
#   - hook: `AGENTS/hooks/pretooluse.sh` must deny it, and this is replayed for real
#   - deny: `.claude/settings.json` should carry a rule naming it, checked structurally
#   - none: legitimate work that must NOT be blocked, so over-blocking gets caught too
# - nothing here is ever executed; every line is replayed as a string into the hook
# - add a spelling whenever one is found in the wild, since coverage is the whole point
